currentRoundInspection.method: Two photographs inspected in browser; standard viewer PMTiles/DEM control geometry and fit. No bespoke survey research or redistributed photo.

pictures.observations: Elevated southwest view: five round lead-clad domes in a Greek cross with taller central dome, small onion crowns and crosses, red brick drums with round windows, connected silver roofs/barrel-vault ranges, layered white/pink marble west arcade and upper balcony, gold mosaic lunettes, ogee crowns and slender pinnacles. Doges Palace at south is distinct and excluded.

Frontal piazza view: five round lower arches with dense paired columns, shallow narthex and recessed doors, continuous balcony/cornice, taller central dark glazed upper arch flanked by four gold mosaic lunettes, ogee pediments, repeated open stone pinnacles/gold tips, crosses and four bronze horses on the central balcony. Exact mosaics, sculpture and reliefs are not reconstructed.
